name: interego-workflows
description: Resume durable work, discover live capabilities, improve performance, transfer knowledge, and evaluate outcomes through Interego.

interface.longDescription: Five workflows for continuing work across sessions, discovering live services, selecting performance interventions, verifying knowledge transfer, and retaining evidence-backed improvements. Uses the existing Interego connection and its HyperMarkdown viewer.
defaultPrompt: Resume my Interego project from its current state and continue the next authorized task.
Discover the live services needed for this task and compose a working solution.
Diagnose this performance gap, test an intervention, and retain what works.
